title: Implement synchronous scoring API behind Envoy Gateway
description: Build a Docker-backed Kubernetes proof of concept for Plexus scoring over HTTP through Envoy Gateway. The POC adds a synchronous scoring API worker mode, Helm resources for Gateway API routing, local bootstrap documentation/scripts, and focused tests/render checks. Existing SQS-based infrastructure remains separate and unchanged.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Starting implementation. Scope: synchronous scoring API worker mode, Envoy Gateway Helm resources, local Docker-backed Kubernetes POC docs/scripts, and focused automated validation. Existing SQS infrastructure will not be changed.
